incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1849004328 - Production inference error spike detected
incident-bot: Brief: elevated 5xx error rate on hosted inference (text-generation) across us-west-2. Error rate 18% over last 6m, baseline ~0.6%. Affected model: rwd-mdl-v2.
incident-bot: Links: dashboard https://console.redwood/d/alerts/1849004328 | runbook https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx

Tom Baker: I'm on call and on it. pulling logs now.

Priya Singh: pinged Tom, thanks. if you need a hotfix window, I can open one with infra.

Tom Baker: quick snapshot: errors are coming from KV cache OOMs after a config rollout. saw many "kv_get_failure" in logs. rolling back the rollout to previous kernel config now.

Javier Ortega: good call. which rollout? the kernel-selection change from this morning?

Tom Baker: yes, kernel-selector v3.4 -> v3.5. rolling back to v3.4 on the affected pool (pool-west-1). running `kubectl -n inference set image` then `redwood-deploy rollback pool-west-1 --to v3.4`

Tom Baker: rollback started. ETA ~4m. will monitor error rate.

incident-bot: Action: rollback triggered by Tom Baker. Severity -> Sev2. Pager duty notified.

Marta Ruiz: heads up CS: any idea which customers hit? I'm starting outreach prep.

Tom Baker: initial query for affected customers:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS failed_requests, sum(tokens) AS impacted_tokens
FROM logs.inference
WHERE timestamp >= '2026-11-12T00:10:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2026-11-12T00:40:00Z' AND response_code >= 500
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY failed_requests DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Tom Baker: preliminary top-5 affected: acct-993, acct-210, acct-44, acct-177, acct-612. total impacted tokens ~1.2M (estimate).

Priya Singh: rollback completed. error rate dropping, currently 0.9% over last 3m. reverting autoscaler patch too.

Tom Baker: confirm: rollbacks stable and we're trending to baseline. setting incident status -> mitigated. will leave monitor at high cadence for next 2h.

incident-bot: Status update: mitigated -> monitoring.

Marta Ruiz: thanks team. I'll draft customer comms for impacted accounts and ask for approval. does Finance need a headstart on potential SLA credit calc?

Alice Kim: tagging Finance-Bot. please capture impacted window and token counts. we'll need estimated credit and a journal entry.

Finance-Bot: received. please provide final impacted window, list of customers (customer_id + product tier), and estimated token shortfall. FYI SLA credit formula = max(0, outage_minutes / SLA_window) * monthly_commit_proportion (per contract).

Tom Baker: final window we used for queries: 2026-11-12T00:10:00Z -> 2026-11-12T00:40:00Z. confirmed impacted tokens 1,218,400 across 37 paying customers. attaching CSV to incident doc. (link in channel)

Javier Ortega: proposed follow-ups:
- Postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 PST (owner: Javier Ortega)
- Action item 1: instrument kernel-selector canary checks (owner: Tom Baker, ticket TKT-3456)
- Action item 2: add KV cache OOM alert with runbook link (owner: Priya Singh, ticket TKT-3457)
- Action item 3: billing impact calc + draft SLA credit (owner: Alice Kim, ticket FIN-212)

Priya Singh: added TKT-3457 to backlog and started a small PR for alert thresholds.

Tom Baker: TKT-3456 created, initial PR link: https://git.redwood/r/tkt-3456. includes additional healthcheck endpoints and a canary traffic path.

Marta Ruiz: scheduling comms review with legal at 08:45 PST tomorrow, will bring the customer list.

Alice Kim: I'll pull contract terms and start credit calc. can you paste the CSV or raw list here? need product tiers (standard/premium/enterprise).

Tom Baker: pasted CSV link: https://files.redwood/incidents/1849004328/impacted_customers.csv (includes tier column).

Finance-Bot: assigned FIN-212 to Alice Kim. expected deliverable: credit amount per customer + aggregated journal entry by EOD next business day. tagging @accounting for follow-through.

Javier Ortega: postmortem agenda: timeline, root cause (kernel-selector fallback logic), detection & alerting gaps, mitigations & rollback steps, remediation plan (TKT-3456/3457), customer impact & SLA credits, owners & deadlines.

Priya Singh: I'll update the runbook with the rollback playbook and note the canary check insertion point.

Tom Baker: handoff: I'm finishing post-rollback checks. Priya, I'm handing overnight monitoring to you at 01:10 PST. brief: rollback done, monitoring for 2h, watch for any regressions when autoscaler patches are reintroduced. all mitigation steps documented in the incident doc.

Priya Singh: taking handoff. thanks Tom. I'll be here until 05:30 PST and will escalate if error rate >1.5% and persist for 5m.

Marta Ruiz: once Alice has numbers, I'll finalize comms and send targeted emails to top-5 affected with proposed credit.

Alice Kim: preliminary estimate: aggregated credit ~ $6,400 across impacted customers (subject to contract terms). will confirm after verifying tiers and monthly commits.

Finance-Bot: Finance action: prepare provisional credit entries and await Alice confirmation. deadline: EOD next business day.

incident-bot: Post-incident: schedule postmortem doc created at https://wiki.redwood/incidents/1849004328/postmortem | meeting invite sent to #incidents and attendees.

Javier Ortega: assigning owners + deadlines inside postmortem doc. expected completion of remediation PRs: 2 weeks.

Priya Singh: quick note - we should add synthetic KV cache load tests to CI to catch regressions before rollout. adding to TKT-3456 as subtask.

Tom Baker: thanks everyone. marking this thread for follow-up checks tomorrow after the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Marta Ruiz: acknowledged. I'll keep CS & customers updated.

Alice Kim: will post FIN-212 update in thread when finalized.

Finance-Bot: closing finance action until Alice confirms numbers.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incident timeline.
